_comment: Wix MCP server -- docs search, Wix REST spec lookup, and live site/account
API calls. Used for the Wix-to-Pages cutover (see DEPLOY-GITHUB-PAGES.md).
This is the OAuth variant: no secret lives in this file, which matters
because this repo is PUBLIC. First use opens a browser to authenticate.
The DNS half of the cutover CANNOT use this config. The Domain DNS API is
account-level-API-key only and explicitly rejects the standard auth header,
so it needs the second config documented in DEPLOY-GITHUB-PAGES.md -- which
carries a key and therefore belongs in the USER-level config, never here.
